mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DIARY WHERE petId=#{petId} AND diaryDate=sysdate
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIARY (diaryid, petid, diarydate, walkvenue, walkstart, walkstop, walkdistance) VALUES (Diary_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{petId}, sysdate, #{walkvenue}, #{walkstart}, #{walkstop}, #{walkdistance})
mapper.update: UPDATE DIARY SET walkvenue = #{walkvenue}, walkstart = #{walkstart}, walkstop = #{walkstop}, walkdistance = #{walkdistance} WHERE petId = #{petId} AND diaryDate < sysdate+1 AND diaryDate > sysdate-1
